analysis: This PR changes only a test file, provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/NemotronSuperServingPolicyTests.swift. The patch hunks (lines ~297, 305, 324) update expected prefix-bank sizes: 12<<28 to 10<<28, 34<<28 to 32<<28, 22<<29 to 21<<29, and 29<<28 to 27<<28. The comment values for the lane and image charge were adjusted to match (3 GiB to 2.5 GiB, 8.5 GiB to 8 GiB). These look like test expectations tracking a production sizing change in NemotronSuperServingPolicy.defaultPrefixBankBytes, which is outside the supplied evidence. The prefix bank is in-RAM bank memory. The effect is slightly smaller bank sizes, so it reduces rather than widens the T-041 exposure; it does not touch SSD cache crypto, HMAC lookup tags, TTL, salt scoping, or the KEK. The remaining units (lines 445-895) are unchanged context: memory-claim, admission, load-fit and quote tests, including the media-charge gating that the DoS and memory-cap logic relies on. Those tests assert fail-closed behavior with memory-cap rejection and capability rejection for out-of-binding image counts. No new attack surface, authorization or attestation change, secret handling, or network path appears in the changed lines. Open question for integration: the production source change that shifts the bank sizing is not in this batch. Reviewers should confirm it keeps the claim plus activation floor under the hard cap and keeps the bank within the lane and admission budget (the tests at lines 464-504 assert this).
